boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 112 starts with two oversized purple bars — a `7` and a `10` — that shrink through row and column slides into smaller counters as the board contracts. The solve is a slow implosion: the bars break down stage by stage until only a center `3` zone remains. Force a perimeter slide before the big bars have split and the entire collapse sequence jams.
landmarks: Block Out Level 112 starts with two oversized purple bars — a `7` and a `10` — that shrink through row and column slides into smaller counters as the board contracts.
The solve is a slow implosion: the bars break down stage by stage until only a center `3` zone remains.
Force a perimeter slide before the big bars have split and the entire collapse sequence jams.

quickTips: The numbered tray tiles at the bottom are finishers — sliding them early closes the green smiley lane.
Use the top purple arrows to split the `7` bar away from the `10` block before touching the center.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Slide the left blue vertical column upward along the red left arrow to free the top `7` bar.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Push the `7` bar rightward until it splits from the `10` block and the upper board opens on both sides.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Rotate the green smiley bar leftward through the new gap without touching the numbered tray tiles (`1`, `4`, `3`).

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Collapse the `10` bar into the center zone using the top purple arrows until the board shows a single `3` pocket.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Clear the scattered edge blocks (red left, blue top, green right, yellow bottom) one at a time around the `3` zone.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Feed the orange `1` and yellow `4` tray tiles through the bottom arrows to finish the last perimeter clears.

failurePoints: Sliding the bottom numbered tray tiles (`1`, `4`, `3`) before the `7` and `10` bars have split.
Forcing the green smiley bar downward while the center `3` pocket is still boxed in.
